_meta.description: Packaging & transport performance testing (ASTM D4169-22 Version)

parameters.Description_EN: Manual handling drop tests. Drop height is determined by package weight and assurance level.
parameters.Description_ZH: 模擬人工搬運與包裹上下貨時的摔落。分為三次不同高度層級的跌落，確保邊角與面受到衝擊。
parameters.Drop Sequence: One corner, one edge, then remaining faces.

parameters.Description_EN: Simulates dynamic bottom-load compression during vehicle vibration using default density factor Mf = 10 lb/ft³ (160 kg/m³).
parameters.Description_ZH: 模擬底層包裹在運輸途中承受上方貨物重量時的動態振動破壞力。使用預設密度因子 Mf = 10 lb/ft³ (160 kg/m³)。
parameters.Variables: W: Package weight, H: Stack height, h: Package height

parameters.Description_EN: Simulates unrestrained package bouncing and colliding in a vehicle.
parameters.Description_ZH: 模擬未固定的包裹在卡車車廂內跳動與互相碰撞。
parameters.Duration: Depends on DC, typically 40 to 120 minutes
parameters.Frequency: Typically ~4-5 Hz (rotary or vertical synchronous motion)

tests.Condition: Machine speed adjusted so package leaves table by ~1.6mm (1/16 in)

parameters.Description_EN: Simulates longitudinal shock during railcar coupling.
parameters.Description_ZH: 模擬火車車廂連結時產生的巨大縱向衝擊。

tests.Condition: Perform incline impact or horizontal shock test

parameters.Description_EN: Simulates localized impacts from adjacent freight or handling equipment.
parameters.Description_ZH: 模擬尖銳物體或鄰近貨物倒塌造成的局部撞擊。

tests.Condition: Free fall of a standard hazard box onto the package
